onboarding.title: 👋 Thanks for adding ArkenBot!
onboarding.description: ArkenBot just joined **{server}**. Here's how to get set up in a couple of minutes:
onboarding.step1Value: Log in to the [dashboard]({dashboardUrl}) with Discord, select **{server}**, and enable the features you want — moderation, leveling, tickets, stream alerts, and more.
